title: Claude Fable 5
content:
## Overview

Claude Fable 5 is Anthropic's most capable generally available model, released June 9, 2026. It is based on the **Mythos-class architecture** — the same underlying model as Claude Mythos 5, but with additional safety safeguards applied for general use. Fable 5 is state-of-the-art on nearly all tested benchmarks, with exceptional performance in software engineering, scientific research, finance, and vision tasks.

---

## What Is the Mythos Architecture?

Mythos represents a step-change in capability beyond the Claude 4.x family. Anthropic ran the Mythos model in restricted preview (as "Project Glasswing") for several months before releasing a safeguarded version — Fable 5 — to the general public. Claude Mythos 5 remains a separate, restricted release available only to vetted cybersecurity and infrastructure providers, with some safeguards lifted.

When Fable 5's safety filters are triggered (in fewer than 5% of sessions on average), the request is routed to Claude Opus 4.8 instead.

---

## Benchmarks

| Benchmark | Fable 5 | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| SWE-Bench Pro | **80.3%** | +11 points over the next-best model |
| FrontierBench | **#1** | Cognition's frontier coding eval |
| Anthropic Analytics Benchmark | **90%+** | First model to break 90%; +10 pts over Opus |
| Frontier Physics Research | **State-of-the-art** | Reached GPT-5.5's 4-day result in ~36 hours |

As a qualitative demonstration, Fable 5 completed Pokémon FireRed using only raw game screenshots — no maps, no navigation aids, and no helper harness that prior models required.

---

## Pricing & Availability

| Channel | Status |
|---|---|
| Claude API | Generally available |
| Consumption-based Enterprise | Generally available |
| Pro / Max / Team / seat-based Enterprise | Free through June 22, 2026; then standard pricing |
| GitHub Copilot | Generally available |
| Amazon Bedrock | Generally available |
| Databricks (Unity AI Gateway) | Generally available |

**API pricing:** $10 per million input tokens / $50 per million output tokens.

**Maximum output tokens:** 128,000 per request.

---

## Key Differences from Opus 4.8

- **Capability:** Substantially more capable on coding, analytics, and research benchmarks
- **Safety routing:** Fable 5 routes ~5% of sessions to Opus 4.8 as a fallback; Opus 4.8 has no such routing
- **Reasoning efficiency:** Uses roughly one-third the reasoning tokens of earlier Mythos-class models to reach equivalent results on physics benchmarks
- **Output limit:** 128K max output tokens vs. standard output for Opus 4.8
- **Cost:** Both priced at $10/$50 per MTok, but Fable 5 produces longer, more complete outputs per turn on complex tasks

---

## Deprecations

With Fable 5's release, Anthropic deprecated Claude Opus 4.1 and scheduled its retirement from the Claude API on **August 5, 2026**.
